title: OpenAI in $30 Billion Round Talks With UAE Funds, BlackRock
source_used: Chosunbiz (https://biz.chosun.com/en/en-it/2026/10/06/L5WL4M46G5FZTK7C2OVLJRQ3OQ/), Reuters brief carried by TradingView, Cryptonomist; all relay Bloomberg. Bloomberg page itself blocked (HTTP 403).
key_facts: Bloomberg reported on 5 Oct 2026, citing people familiar, that OpenAI is in talks to raise at least $30 billion in fresh funding at a valuation of about $1.4 trillion.
Several UAE investment funds, including Abu Dhabi's MGX, have discussed investing as much as $10 billion, and are considering forming a syndicate.
BlackRock is also in discussions to take part alongside the Gulf funds.
Existing investors including the University of California endowment, Thrive Capital and Andreessen Horowitz are also discussing taking part (Chosunbiz, relaying Bloomberg).
OpenAI has delayed its IPO until at least next year to focus on AI safety (Bloomberg, as relayed by Reuters and Chosunbiz).
OpenAI's previous round, in March 2026, raised $122 billion at a valuation of $852 billion (Chosunbiz; Cryptonomist).
Talks are underway and details could change, according to sources.
quote_evidence: OpenAI is in talks with multiple UAE investment funds, including Abu Dhabi's MGX, to participate in OpenAI's $30 billion financing round Bloomberg reported, citing sources.
However, talks are underway and details could change, according to sources.

OpenAI is seeking to raise at least $30 billion in fresh funding at a valuation of around $1.4 trillion, Bloomberg reported, as the company delays plans for an IPO until at least next year to focus on advancing its AI safety initiatives.
why_it_matters_hint: A round at about $1.4 trillion would value OpenAI far above the $852 billion of March 2026, with Gulf funds and BlackRock as possible backers.
notes: Bloomberg's own page could not be opened; facts come from outlets that relay Bloomberg's report. No company confirmation seen: Cryptonomist (citing The Next Web) says OpenAI and BlackRock declined to comment and MGX did not reply; not used in the entry.
